subject: Innovation Track collateral, demo-pod placement & exclusivity options
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@innovateconf.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sponsorship Ops <ops@innovateconf.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sponsorship proposal and demo-pod opportunity for Redwood

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the interest in InnovateConf 2027 — we loved the MAPLE demo at the partner preview. Attached is the sponsor terms (InnovateConf_Sponsor_Terms_v3.pdf) and a high-level floorplan (Booth_Floorplan_A2.png). A few items I wanted to flag up front: 

- Innovation Track lightning talks: we have a 10-minute lightning slot available on Day 2 (limited to 6 vendors). We can provision AV and a standing demo table adjacent to the stage.
- Demo pods: the show floor has 3x demo-pod clusters. We can offer an "Entrance Pod" (highest footfall) as an add-on — exclusivity available at +$9,000 for category exclusivity (AI inference vendors).
- Logo placement: we can guarantee keynote backdrop logo at Platinum tier; for Dedicated pods we usually include a secondary logo placement on the innovation corridor banners.

If you want to pursue the Entrance Pod + lightning slot together I can send a bundled quote and a DocuSign. Otherwise, we can negotiate a reduced fee in exchange for expanded social/promotional commitments.

Attaching: InnovateConf_Sponsor_Terms_v3.pdf, Booth_Floorplan_A2.png

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhou
Director, Partnerships | InnovateConf
ops@innovateconf.com | +1 415 555 0199

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@innovateconf.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship proposal and demo-pod opportunity for Redwood

Emily — thanks for the materials and for outlining the Entrance Pod option. Quick responses below: 

1) Lightning talk (10 min) — we're interested but need to confirm AV specs (micro/line, monitor for live demo, 1x HDMI + laptop). Please confirm available setup so we can size the demo.
2) Entrance Pod exclusivity — $9k is higher than we expected for category exclusivity. Can you share metrics on expected impressions/footfall for the Entrance Pod vs a peripheral pod?
3) Logo placement — we want the keynote backdrop inclusion; can you confirm the sizing and placement (centerline vs corner)?

If you prefer, Ben can run numbers on a bundled sponsorship + paid social endorsement tradeoff (emphasis on paid amplification and 6x posts vs exclusivity). Naomi — looping you for packaging input and any mandatory legal constraints.

Next steps: Emily, can you send a bundled quote (pod + lightning slot) and a sample exclusivity clause we can review with legal? If there's flexibility on the exclusivity fee in exchange for a comms package, that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 628 555 0172

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship proposal and demo-pod opportunity for Redwood

Jonas / Ben — two quick notes from the ops/legal side: 

- Exclusivity clause: ask for a time-bound category exclusivity limited to the footprint of Entrance Pod for the event days only (not a year-long restriction). Also request a defined remedy (pro rata credit) if another competitive vendor is inadvertently placed nearby.
- AV rider: request a 2-hour continuous power allotment and a dedicated ethernet drop for remote demos; mention that our demo requires a small GPU box (will provide spec sheet).

I can draft a short redline of the exclusivity paragraph once we see Emily's sample.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
VP, Events & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@innovateconf.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship proposal and demo-pod opportunity for Redwood

Emily — appreciate the quick follow-up. Couple of commercial options that would work for Redwood: 

Option A (Entrance Pod + Lightning Talk): Entrance Pod (category exclusivity) + 10-minute Innovation Track slot + keynote banner logo — $24,000 total. Includes 2x dedicated AV passes, 1x supplier power+ethernet, and 2x pre-event social blasts.

Option B (Perimeter Pod + Comm Package): Peripheral demo pod (non-exclusive) + Lightning Talk + expanded comms: 6x coordinated social posts, 3x sponsored newsletter mentions, and a dedicated booth listing — $14,500. We would propose this as an alternative to exclusivity.

We prefer Option B if you can make the comms package explicit — broader reach and measurable KPIs (paid impressions & link clicks). If the Entrance Pod is locked to exclusivity, we'd like a clause that exclusivity is event-days-only and provides a partial credit if another vendor with overlapping product is later added.

Attaching our standard rider for logistics: Sponsorship_Rider.docx

Please send a DocuSign when you have the updated quote + sample exclusivity wording and we'll aim to finalize by Monday.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0144

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@innovateconf.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship proposal and demo-pod opportunity for Redwood

Hi Ben / Jonas / Naomi — thanks for the clear options and the rider. After checking with ops, we can do Option B (Perimeter Pod + Comm Package) with a tailored comms deliverable: 6x coordinated social posts (pre/during/post), 2x newsletter features (pre & post), and an on-site spotlight mention during the Innovation Track — total $14,250.

We will not charge for exclusivity in this arrangement. Instead, we will reserve the Entrance Pod for another partner but guarantee a higher-traffic perimeter placement and the Innovation Track spot. AV spec for the lightning talk: 1x lectern mic, 1x handheld, 1x HDMI (adapter), 1x 55" monitor on a stand, and an ethernet drop. Please confirm you can operate with those and provide the GPU box spec sheet before Friday.

I'll prepare a DocuSign with the confirmed package and payment terms (50% on signing, balance 30 days prior to event). Expect the envelope by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhou
Director, Partnerships | InnovateConf
